name: Donations
description: Donation campaigns with a goal thermometer, preset or custom amounts, always-available manual payment instructions plus optional Stripe Checkout, donor management and CSV export. GiveWP-style, sandbox-native.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read campaigns, donations and the plugin's own settings table (Stripe key lives there, never in options).
Create the plugin tables and record campaigns, donations and payment-status changes.
Read the non-secret donations configuration (currency, presets, manual payment instructions, notify email).
Public donation/confirmation endpoints for the Puck block and admin CRUD/export endpoints.
Add the Donaciones entry to the admin sidebar.
Send thank-you/receipt emails to donors and notify the administrator about new donations (donations still work if mail fails).
Create and verify Stripe Checkout sessions against api.stripe.com when a Stripe key is configured (optional feature).
